name: Everyday preamble
description: My go-to set of packages for any article or report: fonts, margins, maths, tables, figures, links.
notes: Order: everything else first, then `hyperref`, then `cleveref` last.
`microtype` improves spacing and line breaks for free. Always include it.
Download the `.sty` and `\usepackage{everyday-preamble}` to keep every document consistent.
With `T1` fontenc, accented characters and `<`/`>` in text come out right.
